name: Multi-monitor fixes
description: Monitor hotplug without a shell reload: panels unregister by the screen name latched at creation (Quickshell reassigns a dying window's screen to a survivor), Visibilities ignores stale unregisters, the wallpaper-manager role is handed to a surviving screen, the notch no longer strands an invisible view on unfocused screens, fullscreen detection sees games on the special workspace an output has open, and ~15 screen.name bindings are null-guarded during teardown.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Reads Hyprland monitor state through Quickshell.Hyprland
